{{Top|leg}}
'''Llona''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Llona carried a [[B22 Hold-Out Blaster|Model B22 hold-out blaster pistol]] for self-defense, and had seen the weapon in the hands of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] remnants and those with murder contracts.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
